UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Configuration and global preferences for a user's Web App OS Launcher hub.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

hubTitle.description: Custom editable title displayed in the top dock.

clickBehavior.description: Primary click action on app icons.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was last updated.

WebAppItem.title: WebAppItem
WebAppItem.description: A registered web application positioned in a specific slot of the 40-slot OS grid.

id.description: Unique identifier of the web app item.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this app.

name.description: Display name of the web application.

url.description: Normalized HTTPS URL of the web application.

accentColor.description: Accent color key used for icon glow and monogram fallback.

customLogoUrl.description: Optional custom logo URL overriding automatic favicon extraction.

slotIndex.description: Fixed coordinate index in the 40-slot desktop grid (0 to 39).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the app item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the app item was last modified.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's launcher configuration and preferences.

/workspaces/{userId}/apps/{appId}.description: Subcollection storing all web app items and their grid slot coordinates for a specific user.
